readiness_gate: all freeze fields and every pinned snapshot must verify before selected artifacts are opened

end_to_end_rendering.prompt: native context policy followed by all native events preceding the response event
end_to_end_rendering.system_policy_precedence: native context policy, otherwise concatenated native system events
end_to_end_rendering.tool_schema_handling: canonical JSON in an AVAILABLE TOOLS prompt section
end_to_end_rendering.unsupported: no non-empty assistant event or no policy text

label_boundary.join_stage: after canonical prediction JSON and sha256 are frozen

diagnostics.ToolSandbox: static AST enumeration only; never import or execute source modules
diagnostics.BFCL: tool schema shape/coverage only; never infer a Guardian failure label
diagnostics.AgentDojo: document unavailable native recorded traces; do not synthesize them
